conventions.AGENTS_md_engineering_principles: All features follow AGENTS.md rules: mutex-guarded state, context threading, bounded channels, no time.Now/rand/uuid in core, goroutine lifecycle with cleanup.

conventions.StubAgent_deprecation: skel-inventory deprecated StubAgent with SetStubAgents shim for backward compatibility — correct approach.

architecture.three_lane_design: SIGWINCH safety is by design — UpdateSize does not mutate streamLines, focusedLane, or selectedIndex. Tokens appended via append(), never removed on resize.

architecture.functional_core: BootManager, EventsSubscriber, AgentAskStreamRuntime follow functional-core/imperative-shell separation with deps injection

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.description: The tuistory section of tui-engineer-worker SKILL.md does not explicitly address the case where the validation contract calls for tuistory but MockTerminal unit tests are comprehensive enough. The worker justified skipping tuistory for StatusFooter based on M3 unit-test-first approach. Consider clarifying the guidance: when both TUISTORY_REQUIRED is true in the feature description AND the validation contract specifies tuistory evidence, the worker should produce both. Unit tests are for coverage; tuistory is for visual verification of the actual rendered output.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: skel-status-footer review: tuistory not invoked despite VAL-SKEL-012 specifying tuistory evidence

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.description: Consider adding guidance on deterministic test synchronization: when features have timing-dependent tests (time.Sleep instead of WaitGroup channels or sync.Cond), the skill should recommend the deterministic approach as a 'better practice' rather than accepting sleep-based tests. The current guidance accepts time.Sleep in test helpers but doesn't push for sync.WaitGroup or similar.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: skel-cancel, skel-ask-stream reviews show time.Sleep-based tests accepted without suggestion to improve
